law: Quality picks the model. Cost only breaks a tie.
note: Owner-run read-only observation of 7 September 2026. Counts describe LXC containers and QEMU virtual machines, not application health. It does not establish backup coverage, demonstrated recovery, storage redundancy, failover readiness, or model-routing behavior. Private operational details have been redacted; original observation dates are unchanged.
